cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(HmiAudioSdk LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(NOT APPLE AND NOT WIN32)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This SDK entry point supports macOS and Windows.")
endif()

set(_audio_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/source")
set(_audio_extension "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hmi-extension")
set(AUDIOCPP_MODEL_SET custom CACHE STRING "audio.cpp model set")
set(AUDIOCPP_MODELS "qwen3_asr;qwen3_tts" CACHE STRING "audio.cpp models in the SDK")
set(AUDIOCPP_BUILD_C_API ON)
set(AUDIOCPP_DEPLOYMENT_BUILD ON)
if(APPLE)
  if(ENGINE_ENABLE_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The macOS SDK package requires static GGML. Set ENGINE_ENABLE_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS=OFF.")
  endif()
  option(GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY "Embed the upstream Metal shader source" ON)
  option(ENGINE_ENABLE_OPENMP "Use an external OpenMP runtime" OFF)
  option(GGML_OPENMP "Use OpenMP in GGML" ${ENGINE_ENABLE_OPENMP})
endif()

add_subdirectory(source audio-cpp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(APPLE AND ENGINE_ENABLE_METAL AND NOT GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The macOS Metal SDK package requires embedded shaders. Set GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON.")
endif()
include("${_audio_extension}/AudioExtensions.cmake")
hmi_enable_audio_extensions("${_audio_source}" "${_audio_extension}")
add_custom_target(hmi_native_sdk ALL DEPENDS audiocpp)

if(APPLE)
  install(TARGETS audiocpp LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
  install(FILES "${_audio_source}/include/audiocpp.h" "${_audio_extension}/audiocpp_hmi.h"
    DESTINATION include)
  install(FILES "${_audio_source}/UPSTREAM_REVISION" "${_audio_source}/LICENSE"
    DESTINATION share/hmi-audio-sdk)
  file(READ "${_audio_source}/license-manifest.json" _license_manifest)
  string(JSON _license_count LENGTH "${_license_manifest}")
  math(EXPR _last_license "${_license_count} - 1")
  foreach(_index RANGE ${_last_license})
    string(JSON _license GET "${_license_manifest}" ${_index} path)
    if(NOT _license STREQUAL "LICENSE")
      get_filename_component(_license_dir "${_license}" DIRECTORY)
      install(FILES "${_audio_source}/${_license}" DESTINATION "share/hmi-audio-sdk/licenses/${_license_dir}")
    endif()
  endforeach()

  include(CTest)
  if(BUILD_TESTING)
    find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
      add_test(NAME hmi_native_exports COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B
        "${_audio_extension}/verify_exports.py" "${_audio_source}" "${_audio_extension}" "$<TARGET_FILE:audiocpp>")
    endif()
    if(ENGINE_ENABLE_METAL)
      add_executable(hmi_metal_smoke "${_audio_extension}/metal_smoke.cpp")
      target_compile_features(hmi_metal_smoke PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
      target_link_libraries(hmi_metal_smoke PRIVATE engine_runtime)
      add_test(NAME hmi_metal_smoke COMMAND hmi_metal_smoke)
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
